articles.summary: BATON ROUGE, La., April 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lamar Advertising Company (Nasdaq: LAMR) will release its first quarter ended March 31, 2026 earnings report before the market opens on Thursday, May 7, 2026. Lamar will host a conference call on Thursday, May 7, 2026 at 8:00 a.m.
articles.title: Lamar Advertising Company to Release First Quarter Ended March 31, 2026 Operating Results
